The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist, composer, and arranger André Marques. He has been building a solid career, releasing his music with numerous groups: he is a member of the Latin Grammy-nominated Trio Curupira, the André Marques Sexteto, and he leads the Brazilian music orchestra Vintena Brasileira. In this episode of Da Pá Virada Sessions, André Marques performs an intimate solo piano recital.

programme.title: Null + Void
programme.desc: While few people are familiar with the Null + Void project, many have already heard Kurt Uenala's music. After making his debut under the pseudonym Kap10Kurt in 2003, Uenala caught the attention of the world with the play "Die Sleeping". This critical and popular success has led to collaborations with several big names in music, including Moby, The Kills, and Dave Gahan, singer of Depeche Mode, for whom Uenala has subsequently signed plays. Spending more and more time in his Manhattan studio, Uenala developed a unique sound made of angular beats and dark soundscapes, which gave rise to a new melancholy solo project called Null + Void. Cryosleep, Uenala's first album under this new banner, includes several titles inspired by retro science fiction, new wave and electronic innovators. Discover Null + Void at the Sónar Reykjavík 2018 festival.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in Sao Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. Zé Pitoco, a multi-instrumentalist from the Northeastern state of Pernambuco, is an all-encompassing figure in the modern Brazilian scene. He has collaborated with scene artists of name, including Dominguinhos, Hermeto Pascoal, Sivuca, Paulo Moura, Mônica Salmaso, Paula Santoro, and Banda Mantiqueira. Watch him lead his Forró do Zé Pitoco on Da Pá Virada Sessions in a tightly-knit, spirit-lifting set in which the music of Brazil's Northeast meets jazz.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Ethiopian diva Etenesh Wassie with her trio, merges contemporary energies from jazz to punk with an in-depth knowledge of the Ethiopian repertoire. The result is compelling, soulful, and truly unique.

programme.title: Frequencerz @ Airbeat One
programme.desc: Frequencerz is a Dutch hardstyle duo formed by Pepijn Hol and Niels Koster. In 2009, they signed their contract with the Fusion Records label. Since then, they've released a good number of albums, such as Medium Rare, S.T.F.U. / G.T.F.O, and Phaser. With their performances for huge crowds at Defqon.1, Decibel Outdoor, and The Qontinent, they've established themselves as one of the biggest hardstyle acts of today. Their show at the German Airbeat One festival underlines their reputation. Expect nothing but spectacular light shows, non-stop jumpstyle, and a crazy crowd.

programme.title: Pete Doherty & Frederic Lo Live at Le Trianon
MPB Sessions - Pedro Viáfora & Celso Viáfora
programme.desc: Pedro Viáfora and Celso Viáfora are a father-and-son duo that brings together different generations of Brazilian music. Celso is a renowned composer with an extensive discography, while Pedro began his career with the group 5 a Seco before developing his solo work. Together, they reinterpret the tradition of MPB (Brazilian Popular Music) with sharp social commentary, using irony and everyday language to address Brazil's structural challenges while celebrating moments of beauty and poetry. How do contemporary artists reinterpret tradition and create new forms of expression within MPBn Da Pá Virada Sessions' MPB Series investigates this question. Hosted by Dani Gurgel, this episode features a live performance and thought-provoking conversation with Pedro and Celso Viáfora, exploring their unique fusion of styles and inviting audiences to discover the richness of modern Brazilian music. Continue your journey into the rich world of contemporary Brazilian popular music with Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: Moonlight Benjamin - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. One of its showcase participants, Moonlight Benjamin, blends together Voodoo blues, Haitian rock and Creole roll into a riff-heavy, groove-laden sonic concoction built on the tension between her powerful voice and saturated electric guitars.

programme.title: Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music. The resulting music has a festive, almost street-like atmosphere. Panorama de Coro consists of Roberta Valente (pandeiro and percussion), Alexandre Ribeiro (clarinet), Gian Correa (7-string guitar), Henrique Araujo (cavaquinho), Joao Poleto (flute and tenor saxophone) and Yves Finzetto (pandeiro and percussion).

programme.title: Rob Thorne Toi Puo - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, composer/performer/anthropologist Rob Thorne, is a diverse explorer in the newly revived evolution of taonga puoro, traditional Maori instruments, fusing these ancient voices with modern sounds and technology. He creates ethereal and immersive site-specific works as well as contemporary chamber music, born out of in-depth research and respect for tradition.

programme.title: Sing Jazz, Singapore
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album 'Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals. Their December 2010 performance with former backing musicians of Afrobeat founder Fela Kuti in Paris saw them hailed as "the future of Afrobeat".

programme.title: Sgt. Pepper Tribute at Philharmonie de Paris 2017
programme.desc: Celebrated as one of the most influential albums of all times, The Beatles' 1967 Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band marked its time and inspired generations of artists. While the album was purely a recording studio product, Beatles' fans continue to be frustrated by not hearing it live. British musician and composer Ed Harcourt, author of six highly acclaimed albums and collaborator of vocalists Marianne Faithfull, Patti Smith, and trumpeter Erik Truffaz, gathered a supergroup for this occasion with top artists from the British independent rock scene. Join Ed Harcourt and members of The Libertines, Supergrass, The Coral, the Beta Band, and Primal Scream for this special tribute.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic "stretch music"; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band 'Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album 'Jazz Bata''. The bata' repertoire - the deep classical music of West Africa - permeates Valde's' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Norayr Kartashyan & Menua - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Norayr Kartashyan, is acclaimed as one of Armenia's finest woodwind masters and composers, an acknowledged virtuoso numerous traditional Armenian instruments. To name a few: the blul and shvi flutes, duduk, the double-reed zurna trumpet, the pku clarinet, and the parkapzuk bagpipe. Kartashyan's compositions are gently unfolding, delicately intertwined evocations of rural music with a timeless connection to the earth, full of beauty and warmth.

programme.title: Mariana Aydar - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this episode is vocalist Mariana Aydar, who masters the música popular brasileira repertoire (MPB) like no other. She was born in a family of musicians, and has been dubbed the "hottest singer of the moment" by Veja, one of Brazil's leading newsmagazines. For her performance at Da Pá Virada Sessions, Aydar (vocals and triangle) is joined by Cosme Vieira (accordion) and Feeh Silva (zabumba).

programme.title: Sven Väth at Family Piknik 2017
programme.desc: Active on the music scene for more than 30 years, Sven Väth is a true icon of techno. He was one of the first DJs to host a weekly event in Ibiza, and his "Cocoon" nights have quickly become a staple for fans of underground music in all its forms. Väth has been involved in all major developments of the techno movement, but even after three decades, this living legend is not ready to take the backstage and continues to dance crowds on five continents. Experience the unique sounds of Sven Väth with this performance recorded at the 2017 Family Piknik Festival.

programme.title: Kim So Ra - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Korean percussionist Kim So Ra, has played the hourglass-shaped, two-headed drum known as janggu since she was a child. Quietly, she has been taking revolutionary steps to modernize perceptions within traditional Korean music.

programme.title: Giana Viscardi - New Year's Eve Special
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques. After starting their career together, Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques released music in many places around the world. After returning to Brazil, they worked together on Giana's album "ORUM", performing in Africa, Europe, and Brazil. In this New Year's Eve special, presented by Da Pá Virada Sessions and Stingray, Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques perform conductor and arranger Letieres Leite's arrangements of their work with Orchestra Rumpilezz. Enjoy their fantastic Afro-Brazilian jazz, which combines the best of various continents.

programme.title: Quartabe - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Quartabe, a unique Brazilian quartet that has influences ranging as widely as the Sao Paulo avant-garde movement, free improvisation, pop, and electronic music, which all get their due share in the band's exhilarating live performances. Joana Queiroz (tenor sax and clarinets), Maria Beraldo Bastos (clarinets), Mariá Portugal (drums), and Chicao (keys) compose, arrange, improvise, and sing music that's wholly their own.

programme.title: Moderat at Stereolux 2016
programme.desc: Since the German bands Modeselektor (Gernot Bronsert and Sebastian Szary) and Apparat (Sascha Ring) joined forces in 2009, they have been hugely successful as the electronic music supergroup Moderat. In 2012, the formation produced the soundtrack of Xavier Dolan's film Laurence Anyways, released as A New Error. According to Les Inrockuptibles, their album II includes "the rhythmic punch of the one (Modeselektor) and atmospheric finesse of the other (Apparat) combine perfectly." In 2016, the threesome returned with an eagerly anticipated third album, III, which they present in this program, live on stage at Stereolux in Nantes, France.

programme.title: Karin Fernandes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Karin Fernandes. She is dedicated to the performance of 20th and 21st century piano repertoire and has premiered numerous new compositions. As a soloist, Karin Fernandes has performed with prestigious Brazilian orchestras.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Mario Batkovic, aims to explore the sonic possibilities of the accordion, without effects or loops, rather through a mutualist symbiotic relationship between man and instrument. Challenging, hypnotic, and grandiose, Batkovic's single-handed symphonic vision is certainly unique.

programme.title: Salomao Soares Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the Salomao Soares Trio, which consists of Salomao Soares on piano, Paulo Almeida on drums, and Thiago Alves on bass. Band leader Soares was a finalist of the 2017 Montreux Jazz Festival piano competition.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Nelida Karr, sings and plays guitar, piano, cello and percussion. She writes songs suffused with the many influences she assimilated growing up in Malabo in Africa's only Spanish-speaking country, Equatorial Guinea. The result is an eclectic mix that she nevertheless incorporates into a sound all her own.

Altin Gün - BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: The group Altin Gün came to existence when bassist Jasper Verhulst made an inspiring journey to Turkey. After his show in Istanbul, he felt greatly attracted to the Turkish sound from the 1970s. With band members Ben Rider (guitar) and Nic Mauskovic (drums), he went looking for other Turkish musicians to join the band. Soon after, Merve Dasdemir (vocals) and Erdinc Yildiz Ecevit (vocals, saxophone, keys) joined the group. With the energetic Jungle by Night percussionist, Gino Groeneveld, the band was complete. During their 2018 show at BIRD Rotterdam, Altin Gün released their new album "On." Enjoy a new interpretation of Turkish traditional music, with a unique blend of Turkish folk, psychedelics, funk and rock. The show guarantees to make you dance around the campfire.

Paulo is the cousin of singer Bruna Caram, with whom he performed in Sao Paulo, Madrid, Barcelona, Lisbon, and other major cities. As a singer, composer, and instrumentalist, his creativity is enjoyed in many forms. With three albums out and his song 'Perdoa' reaching over 20 million streams on Spotify, he steps into the spotlights time and time again. Now Da Pá Virada Sessions and Stingray present Paulo Novaes in this New Year's Eve special, which was recorded in Paulo's native city of Sao Paulo.

programme.desc: Red Hot Chili Peppers celebrate the return of John Frusciante, who performs in Japan with the band for the first time in 16 years in 2023!

programme.title: At Salle Pleyel 2019
programme.desc: Strongly influenced by Hispanic culture, the English singer-songwriter Anna Calvi makes her voice and guitar vibrate with the ardor of flamenco. She gives a powerful, biting, and incredibly moving performance at the Salle Pleyel in Paris. This performance is part of a European tour to promote Anna Calvi's album Hunter, produced by Nick Launay, and recorded in London and Los Angeles. The album is raw and imbued with the primary energy with which Anna Calvi pushes the limits of her guitar and voice in ways she had never done before. Songs from the setlist include "Hunter," "Away," and "Alpha," with an incredibly generous encore in which Anna performs "Jezebel," "Desire," and "Ghost Rider.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend Joao Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist Joao Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that Joao Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

Parookaville
programme.desc: Parookaville is a city that comes to life once a year to keep the legend of Bill Parooka alive. It was started as an artistic, free-flowing, wild, and musical place where people could connect with their pure selves, experience real connections, and feel a deep sense of bliss and fulfillment. Step into the darkness if you dare, follow your inner light and immerse yourself in a spectacular world of freedom and love! Only four years since the first event, this festival has already become one of Germany's most prevalent music festivals. This edition features Armin van Buuren, Showtek, Robin Schulz, and W&W.

programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic "stretch music"; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Mahmundi
programme.desc: Marcela Vale, known professionally as Mahmundi, is a singer, songwriter, and music producer from Rio de Janeiro. A Latin Grammy nominee, she is recognized for her originality and authenticity in the contemporary Brazilian music scene. Her work, spanning electronic music, indie, and lo-fi with 1980s influences, is defined by poetic and reflective lyrics. In addition to her solo career, Mahmundi is also active as a producer and instrumentalist. How do contemporary artists reinterpret tradition and create new forms of expression within MPBn Da Pá Virada Sessions' MPB Series investigates this question. Hosted by Dani Gurgel, this episode features a live performance and thought-provoking conversation with Mahmundi, exploring her unique fusion of styles and inviting audiences to discover the richness of modern Brazilian music. Continue your journey into the rich world of contemporary Brazilian popular music with Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its participating bands, Invisible World, is based at the jazz crossroads where East European and Mediterranean influences merge and caper off in new directions. Led by Czech bassist Tomás Liska, a prolific idea man of many projects, joined by Turkish violinist Efe Turumtay, Serbian accordionist Nikola Zarić and Moravian drummer Kamil Slezák.

programme.title: Kim So Ra - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Korean percussionist Kim So Ra, has played the hourglass-shaped, two-headed drum known as janggu since she was a child. Quietly, she has been taking revolutionary steps to modernize perceptions within traditional Korean music.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Johnny Marr at Rock en Seine 2019
programme.desc: English musician, songwriter, and singer Johnny Marr has enjoyed an exemplary career since his former band The Smiths split up in 1987. His distinctive guitar sound has been part of such varied groups as The Pretenders, The Cribs, Modest Mouse, and Electronic, the group he co-founded with Bernard Sumner of New Order. Now a living legend, Johnny Marr showcases his incredible singer-songwriter talents on each new album. His recent, hit-packed release Call The Comet (2018) gave us "The Tracers" and "Hi Hello," and his live performances - which usually include some songs from his days with The Smiths - always hit the mark. Enjoy this 2019 show recorded at Rock en Seine in Paris.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Mario Batkovic, aims to explore the sonic possibilities of the accordion, without effects or loops, rather through a mutualist symbiotic relationship between man and instrument. Challenging, hypnotic, and grandiose, Batkovic's single-handed symphonic vision is certainly unique.

programme.title: Gusgus
programme.desc: GusGus was founded in 1995 as a collective of film music creators. After signing a contract with the 4AD label the following year, GusGus became one of the most popular electro formations in Iceland, a status that was cemented internationally by the release of Polydistortion in 1997 Over the next two decades, GusGus explored virtually every sub-genre of electronic music, from house to trance, to techno and trip-hop. Discover GusGus at the Sónar Reykjavík 2018 festival, where founding members Biggi Veira and Daníel Ágúst present the latest album from the band, Lies Are More Flexible. With his exceptional vocal talent, fascinating electronic hacks and subtle arrangements, GusGus promises to impress you.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Nelida Karr, sings and plays guitar, piano, cello and percussion. She writes songs suffused with the many influences she assimilated growing up in Malabo in Africa's only Spanish-speaking country, Equatorial Guinea. The result is an eclectic mix that she nevertheless incorporates into a sound all her own.

programme.title: Frederico Heliodoro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in Sao Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is Frederico Heliodoro. He is one of the most active bass players and composers of the new generation jazz musicians in Brazil. His engaging performances are known for their intensity, virtuosity and experimentalism, inspired by a blend of Brazilian nature, jazz, and contemporary music.

programme.title: Sgt. Pepper Tribute at Philharmonie de Paris 2017
programme.desc: Celebrated as one of the most influential albums of all times, The Beatles' 1967 Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band marked its time and inspired generations of artists. While the album was purely a recording studio product, Beatles' fans continue to be frustrated by not hearing it live. British musician and composer Ed Harcourt, author of six highly acclaimed albums and collaborator of vocalists Marianne Faithfull, Patti Smith, and trumpeter Erik Truffaz, gathered a supergroup for this occasion with top artists from the British independent rock scene. Join Ed Harcourt and members of The Libertines, Supergrass, The Coral, the Beta Band, and Primal Scream for this special tribute.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend Joao Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist Joao Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that Joao Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Oekraine
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra 'INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Ethiopian diva Etenesh Wassie with her trio, merges contemporary energies from jazz to punk with an in-depth knowledge of the Ethiopian repertoire. The result is compelling, soulful, and truly unique.

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: London, England. A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group "Take That", lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: "Let me resubmit ..." Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist. Already in the 40s band of pop music, Robbie is more than an artist consecrated worldwide, is a reference with hits present in the best lists of consecrated DJs. This show at the Roundhouse coincided with the announcement of their 11th solo album, Heavy Entertainment Show, just released. The new album's title reflects Williams' performance as energy-dense as his 11-member big band, including his hits partner Guy Chambers on the piano. A formidable 90 minute pop odyssey. Mixing tracks from his Take That era, old or new, his songs allow him to reclaim his throne from an artist who dominates the stage - in fact, there is no one in pop music who combines his monumental energy with music Touching. A magical moment can be perceived in "A Better Man", only with the guitar on stage; Proof that he is an artist that goes beyond the scenery.

programme.title: Lindsey Buckingham - Songs From Small Machine: Live in L.A
programme.desc: Saban Theatre, Beverly Hills, California. Filmed in high definition at an exclusive show at the Saban Theatre in Beverly Hills in April 2007, "Songs From The Small Machine" captures Lindsey Buckingham showcasing tracks from his studio album "Seeds We Sow", songs from across his solo career and Fleetwood Mac classics. His distinctive guitar picking style and instantly recognisable voice are joined to his dynamic on stage presence to deliver a show that brings the audience to their feet and leaves them calling for more. Starting with five solo acoustic performances, Lindsey is then joined by his band to rock their way through the rest of the set before a final acoustic encore of "Seeds We Sow" brings a perfect evening to an end.

programme.desc: United States. James Todd Smith III, best known by the stage name of LL Cool J, is an American hip-hop artist and actor. He is best known for his romantic ballads.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Germany. Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of \"Rock N Roll Damnation\" and \"What's Next To The Moon\" and more.

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Arena di Verona, Verona, Italy. Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

programme.title: Paul Rodgers - Free Spirit
programme.desc: United Kingdom. The 16-song collection, 'Free Spirit', filmed in London, England returned Paul Rodgers to his roots, bringing fans an extraordinary evening celebrating the music of Free.

programme.title: 30 Seconds To Mars - Live in London 2013
Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: USA. Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: John Mayall - 70th Birthday Concert
programme.desc: . Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.

Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: Hammersmith Apollo, London, UK. Jerry Lee Lewis is one of the founding fathers of Rock n Roll. He was one of the original Sun Records quartet along with Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins and Johnny Cash who between them defined the music of a generation. His recording career has stretched from the mid-50s to the present day and his unique style of piano playing has influenced scores of musicians over the years. This concert, recorded at London's Hammersmith Apollo in 1989, features the killer in performances of his classic tracks such as Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On, What Id Say, High School Confidential and Great Balls Of Fire all delivered in his own inimitable fashion. Joining him on stage are a great list of guests including Van Morrison, Dave Edmunds, John Lodge, Brian May, Stuart Adamson and Dave Davies.

programme.title: Jeff Beck - Rock and Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
programme.desc: Irridium Jazz Club, New York City. Filmed on 9 June 2010 at the Irridium Jazz Club in New York City, forever associated with the legendary Les Paul, this show captures Jeff Beck celebrating the great man with a selection of Les Paul songs and other great rock 'n' roll tracks on what would have been Les Paul's 95th birthday. Jeff Beck is joined by some very special guests including Imelda May and her band led by Darrel Higham on many of the tracks plus appearances by Gary US Bonds, Brian Setzer and Trombone Shorty. The intimate setting puts you right there in the audience for a performance featuring stunning musicianship and truly great songs.

programme.desc: London, UK. Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without Youn", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.title: Jeff Beck - Rock and Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
programme.desc: Irridium Jazz Club, New York City. Filmed on 9 June 2010 at the Irridium Jazz Club in New York City, forever associated with the legendary Les Paul, this show captures Jeff Beck celebrating the great man with a selection of Les Paul songs and other great rock 'n' roll tracks on what would have been Les Paul's 95th birthday. Jeff Beck is joined by some very special guests including Imelda May and her band led by Darrel Higham on many of the tracks plus appearances by Gary US Bonds, Brian Setzer and Trombone Shorty. The intimate setting puts you right there in the audience for a performance featuring stunning musicianship and truly great songs.

programme.title: Michael Bolton - Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: London, UK. Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without Youn", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.title: John Mayall - 70th Birthday Concert
programme.desc: . Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.

programme.title: Wojna polsko-ruska
programme.desc: 26-letni Silny (Borys Szyc) należy do subkultury dresiarzy. Od urodzenia mieszka na blokowisku w małym mieście na Pomorzu. Nie pracuje, nie uczy się i nieustannie popada w konflikt z prawem. Podobnie jak jego najlepszy kumpel Lewy (Michał Czernecki) nie ma perspektyw, ani pomysłu na dalsze życie. Chłopak jest szaleńczo zakochany w powierzchownej i interesownej blondynce, Magdzie (Roma Gąsiorowska), z którą łączą go skomplikowane relacje. Pobudzony amfetaminą Silny jest wściekły na cały świat, uważa się za antyglobalistę, a szczególną nienawiścią pała do bliżej nieokreślonych ruskich. Jego dziwaczne, pełne niejasności konfrontacje ze światem urozmaicają spotkania z kolejnymi niezwykłymi kobietami. Na drodze bohatera stają bowiem: mroczna, a zarazem proekologiczna dziewica Andżela (Maria Strzelecka), z pozoru nieśmiała studentka ekonomii Ala (Anna Prus), porywcza i pewna siebie Natasza (Sonia Bohosiewicz), a także młoda policjantka Dorota (Dorota Masłowska), która wymyśliła całą tę historię. Ekranizacja bestsellerowej powieści Doroty Masłowskiej. Autorem scenariusza i reżyserem jest Xawery Żuławski - laureat nagrody za filmowy debiut na FPFF w Gdyni w 2008 r.

programme.title: Nie mów tak do mnie
programme.desc: Tina i Julian, utalentowane muzycznie rodzeństwo, przygotowują się do ważnego koncertu. Jednak na drodze do sukcesu pojawiają się lęki, uzależnienia i nierozwiązane konflikty z przeszłości.

programme.desc: Formacja Chatelet, damska ekipa z kabaretu A Jak, aktorzy Sebastian Stankiewicz i Paweł Koślik oraz inni artyści rozbawiają publiczność skeczami komentującymi absurdy współczesnej rzeczywistości.

programme.title: Robert Makłowicz
programme.desc: Autorski cykl powszechnie znanego z telewizji i internetu, charyzmatycznego Roberta Makłowicza, który od dekad z wdziękiem, erudycją i humorem mówi o smakach, gotuje w ciekawych lokalizacjach, rozmawia z interesującymi ludźmi i opowiada historie z różnych zakątków świata. Tym razem w swoim niepowtarzalnym stylu oprowadza widzów po m.in. Tajlandii, Jordanii, Irlandii, Dalmacji, Bośni i Hercegowinie, Portugalii, Włoszech, Niemczech, Francji oraz Polsce. Każdy odcinek to opowieść o lokalnych smakach, kuchniach, rynkach i straganach. Usłyszymy historie związane z krajobrazami, architekturą, sztuką czy codziennym życiem mieszkańców, a także pospacerujemy uliczkami miast, odwiedzimy puby, winiarnie i wraz z prowadzącym przyrządzimy wyśmienite dania w naturalnych plenerach W ostatniej relacji z Dubaju Robert Makłowicz wyrusza na bezkresne połacie Pustyni Arabskiej. Przemierza jej złociste wydmy, a nawet wznosi się nad nimi balonem, by z nowej perspektywy spojrzeć na surowe piękno krajobrazu. Przy okazji sprawdza, jakie smaki królują w tym niezwykłym otoczeniu. Po powrocie do miasta zagłębia się w jego najstarszą część, gdzie wciąż wyczuć można ducha dawnych czasów. Odwiedza tradycyjny arabski targ, czyli suk, w tym słynną część specjalizującą się w sprzedaży złota. Szczególną uwagę poświęca arabskiej gastronomii w jej różnych odsłonach, odkrywając zarówno klasyczne receptury, jak i ich współczesne interpretacje.

programme.title: Komisarz Rex 5
programme.desc: Funkcjonariusz wiedeńskiej policji Alexander Brandtner (Gedeon Burkhard) rozwiązuje różne zagadki kryminalne. W poszukiwaniach przestępców pomagają mu współpracownicy wśród których są doktor Graf (Gerhard Zemann), Böck (Heinz Weixelbraun) i Höllerer (Wolf Bachofner). W każdym ze śledztw uczestniczy ponadto owczarek Rex. Mądry i odważny czworonóg dzięki czujnemu węchowi i sprytowi trafia na trop nawet najbardziej nieuchwytnych złoczyńców. Jego pomoc okazuje się niezbędna, kiedy zawodzą tradycyjne metody śledcze Na dworcu kolejowym umiera bezdomny Edi Salzer. Jego ciało zostaje znalezione na stacji przeładunkowej. Franziska König i inni funkcjonariusze rozmawiają z kolegami zmarłego, koczującymi w okolicy. Nie są oni chętni do współpracy, ale obecność Reksa skłania ich do zeznań. Pomaga również tajna akcja Brandtnera, który wraz z psem podaje się za bezdomnego i próbuje pozyskać zaufanie potencjalnych świadków. Tymczasem autopsja wykazuje, że przyczyną śmierci Ediego było zatrucie gazem bojowym, sarinem. Brandtner jest przekonany, że sprawca śmierci Ediego będzie chciał wykorzystać niebezpieczny gaz do kolejnej zbrodni.

programme.title: Komisarz Rex 5
programme.desc: Funkcjonariusz wiedeńskiej policji Alexander Brandtner (Gedeon Burkhard) rozwiązuje różne zagadki kryminalne. W poszukiwaniach przestępców pomagają mu współpracownicy wśród których są doktor Graf (Gerhard Zemann), Böck (Heinz Weixelbraun) i Höllerer (Wolf Bachofner). W każdym ze śledztw uczestniczy ponadto owczarek Rex. Mądry i odważny czworonóg dzięki czujnemu węchowi i sprytowi trafia na trop nawet najbardziej nieuchwytnych złoczyńców. Jego pomoc okazuje się niezbędna, kiedy zawodzą tradycyjne metody śledcze Studentka Sybille Lutz nie wraca z wyprawy rowerowej. Przyjaciel dziewczyny, student medycyny Peter Swossil, zgłasza jej zaginięcie. Rozpoczynają się poszukiwania Sybille. Niebawem Rex znajduje jej zwłoki w okolicach przełęczy. Studentka zginęła na skutek pchnięcia nożem, jednak nie udaje się znaleźć narzędzia zbrodni. Znajomi dziewczyny, Hannes Urban i Andrea Platt, na własną rękę badają okoliczności śmierci koleżanki. Po pewnym czasie postanawiają wykopać z grobu trumnę z ciałem Sybille. Mają nadzieję, że dzięki temu trafią na trop mordercy.

programme.title: Vera 5
programme.desc: Detektyw Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn) pracuje w wydziale kryminalnym w malowniczym hrabstwie Northumberland nad Morzem Północnym. Praca jest dla niej całym życiem. Jej współpracownikiem jest zaprzyjaźniony z nią sierżant Joe Ashworth (David Leon). Kiedy jednak mężczyzna awansuje, nowym partnerem Very zostaje Aiden Healy (Kenny Doughty). Serial oparty na powieściach pochodzącej z Northumberland Ann Cleeves. Tytułową bohaterkę zagrała brytyjska aktorka Brenda Blethyn, dwukrotnie nominowana do Oscara: za role w "Sekretach i kłamstwach" Mike'a Leigh oraz "O mały głos" Marka Hermana.

programme.title: Katastrofy w przestworzach
programme.desc: Kulisy katastrof lotniczych ostatnich lat. W każdym odcinku zostanie przedstawiona rekonstrukcja wydarzeń, które doprowadziły do tragedii. Fabularyzowane historie uzupełniają m.in. relacje pilotów.

programme.title: Katastrofy w przestworzach
programme.desc: Rekonstrukcja największych wypadków lotniczych. Dokumentaliści pokazują sytuacje poprzedzające tragedie. W programie znajdą się też komentarze specjalistów i zeznania świadków katastrof.

programme.title: Katastrofy w przestworzach
programme.desc: Rekonstrukcje największych wypadków lotniczych. Każdy z odcinków omawia historię jednego lotu. Twórcy serialu odtwarzają okoliczności, w jakich doszło do tragedii: atmosferę panującą na pokładzie samolotu, decyzje i działania pilotów. Korzystają przy tym z zapisów z czarnych skrzynek. Pokazują też pracę ludzi badających przyczyny owych katastrof i dokonują komputerowej symulacji lotu. Całości dopełniają wywiady z pilotami, ekspertami lotnictwa i świadkami tragicznych wydarzeń. Katastrofy lotnicze wynikają często z ludzkiej opieszałości i braku wyobraźni, pocieszające jest jednak to, że pracownicy przemysłu lotniczego wyciągają wnioski z tragedii i ucząc się na błędach tworzą systemy coraz doskonalsze i coraz mniej zawodne.

programme.title: Wstrząsy
programme.desc: Niewielka górnicza miejscowość Perfection w stanie Nevada. Spokój mieszkańców zakłóca seria budzących grozę wydarzeń. Majsterkowicze Valentine i Earl, którzy przybyli do osady w poszukiwaniu pracy, natrafiają na szczycie słupa elektrycznego na zwłoki mężczyzny. Zmarł on z odwodnienia, gdyż z jakichś powodów obawiał się zejść na ziemię. W makabrycznych okolicznościach ginie też między innymi miejscowy pasterz. Wkrótce przeprowadzająca testy sejsmologiczne studentka Rhonda odkrywa, że za zbrodniami i powtarzającymi się wstrząsami stoją zmutowane, krwiożercze bestie. Przypominają one gigantyczne węże i błyskawicznie przemieszczają się pod ziemią. Uszkadzają linię telefoniczną i drogi. Odcięci od świata mieszkańcy sami muszą podjąć nierówną walkę z potworami.

programme.title: Gry wojenne
programme.desc: Ogarnięty pasją komputerową siedemnastoletni David (Matthew Broderick), włamuje się przypadkowo do systemu amerykańskiej obrony przeciwrakietowej. Chłopak sądzi, że złamał kod zabezpieczający firmy produkującej zabawki i gry. Nie jest zdziwiony, że obok szachów, warcabów i innych programów, komputer proponuje mu wiele opcji strategicznych. David decyduje się wreszcie na program "Światowa wojna nuklearna", przy czym w symulowanej grze staje po stronie wschodniej i rozpoczyna atak na Las Vegas. W centrum dowodzenia armii USA wybucha panika. Ludzkość staje w obliczu wybuchu trzeciej wojny światowej..

programme.title: Cicha noc
programme.desc: Adam na co dzień pracuje za granicą. W Wigilię Bożego Narodzenia niespodziewanie wraca w rodzinne strony - na polską prowincję. Wynajmuje luksusowy samochód, by bliscy myśleli, że dobrze mu się powodzi. Początkowo ukrywa prawdziwy powód swojej wizyty. Wkrótce jednak zaczyna wtajemniczać ojca Zbigniewa, niepijącego alkoholika, który ma odegrać w całej intrydze ważną rolę, brata Pawła oraz innych krewnych w swoje plany. Sytuacja staje się jeszcze trudniejsza, gdy Adam oznajmia, że wkrótce urodzi mu się dziecko. Z każdą godziną atmosfera w domu się zagęszcza. Odżywają dawne pretensje i animozje, a na jaw wychodzą kolejne sekrety. Żaden z obecnych nie spodziewa się, jaki wpływ na jego życie wywrą dalsze wydarzenia tej wigilijnej nocy.

programme.title: Demony wojny wg Goi
programme.desc: ok 1996. Stacjonujący w Bośni polski oddział sił pokojowych, dowodzony przez majora Edwarda Kellera (Bogusław Linda), wbrew woli swoich przełożonych udaremnia dokonanie samosądu na milicjantach. Wkrótce z Polski przylatuje major Czesław Kusz (Tadeusz Huk) z rozkazem przejęcia jednostki. Towarzyszy mu przedstawiciel prokuratury wojskowej porucznik Czacki (Olaf Lubaszenko), który ma przeprowadzić śledztwo w sprawie ostatnich wydarzeń. Tymczasem Keller zarządza misję ratunkową norweskiego śmigłowca, który rozbił się w górach. Tym samym po raz kolejny łamie regulamin, który zabrania opuszczania obozu. Kusz oponuje, ale w końcu przyłącza się do akcji. Żołnierze ratują francuskiego dyplomatę i dziennikarkę, którzy mają kasetę wideo kompromitującą serbskiego prezydenta. Nagranie chce zdobyć grupa bandytów, na czele których stoi bezwzględny Skijo (Slobodan Custic). Tytuł filmu nawiązuje do cyklu sztychów Francisca José Goi y Lucientesa - "Okrucieństwa wojny".

programme.title: Sabina
programme.desc: Sabina (Izabela Kuna) spędza nieudany wieczór w towarzystwie kochanka. Kiedy wsiada do taksówki, zwraca uwagę na Ankę, dziewczynę z niebieskimi włosami. To spotkanie na zawsze odmienia jej życia.

programme.title: Komisarz Rex 11
programme.desc: W rzymskim wydziale zabójstw pracuje wyjątkowy funkcjonariusz. Jest nim wilczur wabiący się Rex. Pies pomaga policjantom w rozwiązywaniu kryminalnych zagadek, kierując się swoją intuicją.

programme.title: Vera 5
programme.desc: Detektyw Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn) pracuje w wydziale kryminalnym w malowniczym hrabstwie Northumberland nad Morzem Północnym. Praca jest dla niej całym życiem. Jej współpracownikiem jest zaprzyjaźniony z nią sierżant Joe Ashworth (David Leon). Kiedy jednak mężczyzna awansuje, nowym partnerem Very zostaje Aiden Healy (Kenny Doughty). Serial oparty na powieściach pochodzącej z Northumberland Ann Cleeves. Tytułową bohaterkę zagrała brytyjska aktorka Brenda Blethyn, dwukrotnie nominowana do Oscara: za role w "Sekretach i kłamstwach" Mike'a Leigh oraz "O mały głos" Marka Hermana.

programme.title: Brunet wieczorową porą
programme.desc: Cyganka przepowiada Michałowi (Krzysztof Kowalewski), że zabije on bruneta, który zjawi się u niego wieczorem. Nie wywołuje to jego niepokoju do czasu, gdy sprawdzają się jej dwie inne wróżby - znajduje zaginiony zegarek, a na loterii padają przewidziane liczby. Niespodziewanie w nocy w jego mieszkaniu zjawia się niejaki Dzidek Krępak, który wkrótce ginie w niejasnych okolicznościach. Michał, zdając sobie sprawę, że wszystko przemawia na jego niekorzyść, usiłuje rozwikłać zagadkę. Z pomocą przychodzi mu przyjaciel Kazik (Wiesław Gołas). Podejrzewają, że za zabójstwem stoi któryś z sąsiadów. Znakomita komedia z charakterystycznym dla Stanisława Barei humorem to kolejny interesujący obraz prezentujący klimat i obyczajowość epoki PRL-u. Współtwórcą dialogów i scenariusza jest Stanisław Tym.

programme.title: SexiPistols
programme.desc: Meksyk, przełom XIX i XX wieku. Nowojorski bank zamierza wybudować wzdłuż terytorium kraju linię kolejową. Wysłannicy biznesmenów, bezwzględni bandyci pod wodzą Tylera Jacksona, okradają mieszkańców wybranych pod inwestycję terenów i grożąc śmiercią, przejmują ziemie za bezcen. By osiągnąć cel, nie wahają się zlikwidować miejscowego bogacza Don Diega. Z wyzyskiem i niesprawiedliwością postanawiają walczyć dwie piękności. Córka zamordowanego, wykształcona dama z dobrego domu, Sara Sandoval, oraz Maria Alvarez córka ubogiego farmera, łączą swoje siły. Obie ślicznotki zaczynają napadać na banki. Szlachetne dziewczyny nie zatrzymują łupów dla siebie, lecz rozdają je potrzebującym. Jednocześnie chcą za wszelką cenę zemścić się na Tylerze. O pomoc w przygotowaniu do ostatecznego starcia z bandytą zwracają się do doświadczonego rewolwerowca. Tymczasem zostaje za nimi rozesłany list gończy.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: II wojna światowa. Stanisław Kolicki (Stanisław Mikulski) jest oficerem wywiadu. Jako szpieg wkrada się w niemieckie szeregi, gdzie prowadzi działalność pod kryptonimem J-23, czyli jako Hans Kloss. W nowym wcieleniu, w mundurze Abwehry dzięki swojemu urokowi osobistemu i sprytowi wykrada najpilniej strzeżone tajemnice III Rzeszy. Kloss kpi sobie z niemieckiego kontrwywiadu i ośmiesza starania gestapo. Swoje zadanie wykonuje tak umiejętnie, że wkrótce awansuje do stopnia kapitana i zostaje odznaczony niemieckim Żelaznym Krzyżem Kloss pracuje nad planem zbombardowania niemieckich zakładów, produkujących najnowszy model czołgu. Prace nadzoruje tam inżynier Meier. Niemcy aresztują łącznika polskiej organizacji podziemnej, dentystę Sokolnickiego, któremu Hans miał przekazać meldunek. W tej sytuacji J-23 musi podjąć ogromne ryzyko i osobiście przekazać informacje dotyczące planowanej akcji Bartkowi, dowódcy oddziału partyzanckiego AL. Kloss dowiaduje się o agencie Wolfie, działającym wewnątrz oddziału. Wyrusza do jednostki, ale zostaje przypadkowo rozpoznany jako niemiecki oficer.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: II wojna światowa. Stanisław Kolicki (Stanisław Mikulski) jest oficerem wywiadu. Jako szpieg wkrada się w niemieckie szeregi, gdzie prowadzi działalność pod kryptonimem J-23, czyli jako Hans Kloss. W nowym wcieleniu, w mundurze Abwehry dzięki swojemu urokowi osobistemu i sprytowi wykrada najpilniej strzeżone tajemnice III Rzeszy. Kloss kpi sobie z niemieckiego kontrwywiadu i ośmiesza starania gestapo. Swoje zadanie wykonuje tak umiejętnie, że wkrótce awansuje do stopnia kapitana i zostaje odznaczony niemieckim Żelaznym Krzyżem Łączniczka podziemia Joanna jedzie do Warszawy z meldunkiem. Przeczuwa swoje aresztowanie, dlatego przekazuje wiadomość współpasażerowi - Wackowi Słowikowskiemu. Tymczasem Kloss zostaje przydzielony do pracy w szkole Abwehry. Jego przełożonym jest płk Kraft. Tam Hans poznaje chłopaka, który wygląda identycznie jak Słowikowski. Okazuje się, że jest to Eryk Getting, brat bliźniak Wacka. Kraft chce dokonać zamiany braci i wysłać Eryka jako jego brata z misją do Palestyny. Kloss musi temu zapobiec i sprawić, by na Bliski Wschód pojechał prawdziwy agent polskiego wywiadu, Wacek Słowikowski.

programme.title: Hansel i Gretel: Łowcy czarownic
programme.desc: Od tragicznych wydarzeń, do których doszło w chatce z piernika, minęło piętnaście lat. Pozostawieni przez rodziców w lesie, uwięzieni przez czarownicę Hansel i Gertel uporali się już z traumą z dzieciństwa, a trudne doświadczenia zamienili na dobrze płatny fach. Oboje stali się znakomicie wyszkolonymi zawodowymi łowcami wiedźm. Są nieustraszeni. Na swojej drodze spotykają różne odrażające stworzenia, które zabijają z imponującą skutecznością. Pewnego dnia waleczne rodzeństwo trafia do miasta nękanego przez siły nieczyste. Burmistrz prosi ich o pomoc w zlikwidowaniu zagrożenia. Łowcy szybko orientują się, że trafili na godnego siebie rywala. Wróg okazuje się tak zły i przebiegły, że przechytrzenie go wymaga wykorzystania wszystkich zdobytych wcześniej umiejętności, wyspecjalizowanego oręża i odwagi. Gretel i jej brata czeka bezlitosna walka, która może nawet kosztować ich życie. W trakcie straceńczej misji rodzeństwo odkrywa prawdę na temat swojego pochodzenia.

programme.title: Ostatni rycerze
programme.desc: Bartok (Morgan Freeman) włada królestwem, wchodzącym w skład wielkiego imperium, którym rządzi skorumpowany i okrutny cesarski minister, Geza Motta (Aksel Hennie). Gdy sprawiedliwy władca przeciwstawia się złemu dostojnikowi, zostaje upokorzony i stracony, a jego elitarne wojska - rozproszone. Obawiając się zemsty, Mott każe śledzić wiernego Bartokowi dowódcę, Raidena (Clive Owen). Niebawem przekonuje się jednak, że ten zupełnie się stoczył po śmierci swojego władcy i popadł w alkoholizm. Odtąd Mott czuje się bezkarny i bezpieczny. Nie wie, że Raiden chce tylko zmylić prześladowcę, gdyż w jego głowie powstaje okrutny i misterny plan zemsty.

programme.title: Żelazny rycerz
programme.desc: Anglia, rok 1215. Możnowładztwo zmusza króla Jana bez Ziemi (Paul Giamatti) do podpisania Wielkiej Karty Swobód. Akt ten ogranicza władzę monarszą głównie w sferze sądowniczej i skarbowej. Jednak król nie ma zamiaru przestrzegać postanowień dokumentu. Rusza na stolicę na czele armii wzmocnionej o duńskich najemników. Londyński arcybiskup Langdon (Charles Dance) zachęca barona Albany (Brian Cox) do stawienia oporu władcy. Arystokrata i templariusz Marshal (James Purefoy) wraz z grupą walecznych rycerzy przygotowują się do obrony zamku Rochester, którego król nie może ominąć w drodze do stolicy..

programme.title: Boże Ciało
programme.desc: Dwudziestoletni Daniel (Bartosz Bielenia) po wyjściu z zakładu poprawczego zostaje skierowany do pracy w stolarni. Trafia do wioski, której mieszkańców podzieliła niedawna tragedia. Wykorzystuje okazję, by spełnić swoje marzenie o byciu księdzem. Udając absolwenta seminarium, zastępuje chorego miejscowego proboszcza (Zdzisław Wardejn). Fałszywy duchowny początkowo budzi swoimi naukami i kazaniami kontrowersje. Improwizacją i pasją nadrabia jednak niedostatki wiedzy z liturgii. Z czasem zrzesza wokół siebie ludzi, zdobywa zaufanie wiernych i staje się ich przewodnikiem w niedoli. Nieoczekiwanie w okolicy zjawia się jego dawny kolega z poprawczaka (Tomasz Ziętek), który grozi mu zdemaskowaniem. Nominowany do Oscara w kategorii najlepszy film międzynarodowy dramat psychologiczny nawiązujący do prawdziwej historii. Film wyreżyserował Jan Komasa, twórca "Miasta 44" i "Sali samobójców".

programme.title: Leben
programme.desc: Niezaradna życiowo studentka Olga (Zofia Justyńska) wprowadza się do mieszkania należącego do jej babci. Na początku uważa, że znalazła się w beznadziejnej sytuacji - nowa współlokatorka działa jej na nerwy, a dobrze znane z dzieciństwa osiedle wydaje się przygnębiającym miejscem. Jednak niespodziewana wizyta w pobliskim barze "Astoria" pozwala jej odkryć, że okolicę zamieszkuje nietuzinkowa, intrygująca społeczność. Spotkania ze znajomymi z dawnych lat budzą w Oldze nadzieję na to, że być może po raz pierwszy poczuje się gdzieś naprawdę u siebie.
